The Aero collection

Glossy translucent shells in sky blue and grass green, molded from clear polycarbonate and tinted all the way through rather than painted on the surface.

Each piece is lit from inside by a soft white diffuser, so the color appears to glow from within the material when you hold it up to the window.

The range includes a speaker, a desk lamp and a pair of headphones, each with rounded capsule forms and visible internal parts.
